EPFO Portal Upgrade Causes Service Disruptions

The Employees' Provident Fund Organisation (EPFO) portal is undergoing an upgrade, leading to service disruptions for members and employers. Access to services, including EPF claims, has been unavailable. The upgrade is nearing completion, with services expected to resume shortly.
